name: M6.Spaces.boundary_words_iff
statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b : M6.Physical.Block N) (v : M6.Pinned.Vector (2*N)), v ∈ M6.Spaces.boundaryWords N a b ↔ ∃ h : M6.Physical.Block N, M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) = v
context:
theorem M6.Spaces.boundary_eval : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N] (a b h : M6.Physical.Block N), M6.Spaces.boundary N a b h = M6.Flatten.flatten N (M6.Physical.boundary N a b h) := by
  intro N inst a b h
  rfl
guidance: Unfold boundaryWords,Character.subspaceWords,B; membership in linear range is an existence witness. Rewrite boundary_eval. Return tactic lines only without leading by.
